title: Kusanagi Nene — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nene's birthday
Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! What a spacious venue!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino told me about it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It seemed like my place would be a tight squeeze for everyone, but we'll have plenty of space here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! So, the people coming today are: Saki, Ichika, Honami, Shiho, Hanasato, Azusawa and Shiraishi. Is that right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yep, that's everyone. I invited Shinonome and Aoyagi too, but they had plans today.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Let's complete the preparations before our guests arrive.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We gotta push those long desks together to make a big table, then put up the decorations, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'll handle the balloons. I created a balloon dispensing device just for today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone. Then—

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: It seems there is someone at the door.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? But it's still so early...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... C-Come in—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shinonome? Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you still getting ready? We're sorry to interrupt when you're hard at work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What happened? I thought you two had plans and couldn't make it today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we're going to a thing nearby. We figured we'd at least show our faces on the way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially since you went out of your way to invite us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So... Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're sorry we didn't bring you a gift. Let us make it up to you another time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You don't need to trouble yourselves with that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem. See you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Your attention please, everybody!
The birthday girl, our songstress, is going to blow out the candles!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It won't be easy now that all eyes are on me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: C'mon, do it, do it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay... Give me a second...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, here I go.
*Blow*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ You have such a lovely smile, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She does! I managed to get a good photo. I'll send it to you later, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you. I'm a little self-conscious, but I'm looking forward to seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Nene! Was it you who put up these decorations?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All these differently colored balloons look wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially the ones around that sign saying, “Happy Birthday Nene!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui put up the balloons, and the sign is Tsukasa and Emu's work.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't think I would make a sign wishing myself a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha, true. I guess it might feel awkward doing that for yourself.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I have sliced the birthday cake, everyone. Please help yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! It looks so good!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, it probably doesn't taste as good as storebought, but it seemed okay when we tried it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You don't mean... Kusanagi, did you bake this yourself?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I did. Well, Tsukasa and the others helped me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Since you were all coming to celebrate with me, I wanted you to have a good time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! Thank you!
I can't believe we're getting to eat homemade cake!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know, you didn't have to go so hard on your own birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I get why you did it though. Knowing your guests are enjoying themselves makes it a good party for you too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
Just wait! This isn't the only thing Nene has ready for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, there's more?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You better believe it! Nene's gonna sing for us all!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Nene has been practicing in the hopes of making today enjoyable for you all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Robo-Nene... You're embarrassing me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What a great idea! Let's hear it, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Nene's giving a special birthday show! I'll grab a front-row seat!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's a lot of pressure... But I hope you enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi, let us say it again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was a lovely birthday party. It was clear how much you wanted everyone to enjoy themselves. Thank you so much for inviting us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was so fun! I wasn't expecting you to entertain us like that on your own birthday! We had such a good time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe we can repay you with a song of our own sometime, like “Happy Birthday” sung by Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a good idea. Hearing Kusanagi sing was inspirational, and I wouldn't mind showing my gratitude for that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kusanagi.
I'm sorry I couldn't make it to your birthday. Allow me to make it up to you at school.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An and Kohane told me about your party. I had been wondering what sort of party you'd throw, but who knew you'd put all that together yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I had an amazing time! Normally we'd be the ones surprising you as the birthday girl, but you kept throwing us new curveballs!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't believe you sang for us. And you took it just as seriously as if you were performing at PXL.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You have such a captivating voice... It's as if there's a whole world unfolding in every song. You really are an incredible singer, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Once again, happy birthday!
Your singing is amazing, Nene! I didn't expect to be so moved at your birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm not one bit surprised that you'd go to such lengths to entertain your guests, Kusanagi. You're a true show performer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi. It sounds like you had a good day, so I'm happy for you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday. Ms. Mochizuki was telling me how your birthday was incredible. I wish I could have heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So you sang on your own birthday...? It's unusual, but it makes sense for you, Kusanagi. I guess you must have been belting it out like you did in that show I saw.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ready, you two?
All together now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It truly was a marvelous party, Nene!
You left every guest smiling!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was happy seeing so many people turn up to celebrate you. You seemed anxious about whether you'd pull it all off, but it was a roaring success.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And it's 'cause you worked really hard to make it happen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You had such a sparkly smile on your face, Nene☆

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
I agree with that assessment.
I would gladly throw a party every day if it meant seeing you smile like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for the birthday wishes, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought I wasn't cut out to throw my own birthday party... But I'm glad I did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: On top of celebrating my birthday, it was a good chance to show my gratitude to the people in my life.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So... Let me say it to you, too. Thank you for always cheering me on.
